name: mr_coloc_library
title: Curated MR and colocalization method library with native R adapters and pinned source acquisition
summary: MR/共定位方法检索、输入兼容性筛选、固定版本官方源码获取及原生R接口；区分算法、变体、概览、诊断与纯fine-mapping
inputs: explicit native analysis config and harmonized CSV or dense regional inputs
outputs: ignored pinned official source cache and SHA receipts
source_policy: Original orchestration/adapters; no third-party source vendored in Git. Immutable official snapshots remain in ignored _upstream_sources/mr_coloc. Conflicting or absent licenses remain unresolved.

verification.limitations: Source acquisition and synthetic native behavior do not establish IV validity or scientific suitability. Advanced source-only algorithms have no unified runtime guarantee.
